name: Lemon (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Lemon (Citrus limon) [Fruits] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, DUKE, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FoodData Central FDC 167746 (Lemons, raw, without peel) - macros, minerals, vitamins, fatty acids, total sugars
USDA FoodData Central FDC 167747 (Lemon juice, raw) - individual sugars glucose/fructose/sucrose
Wang et al. 2021, Foods 10(10):2384, doi:10.3390/foods10102384 (PMC8588450) - HPLC organic acids of fresh lemon juice (citric 51.46, malic 5.80, succinic 1.19, oxalic 1.03, lactic 0.61 g/L)
Penniston et al. 2008 (citric acid in lemon/lime juice, 48-60 g/L) - cross-check
FooDB FOOD00054 (compound presence for phytochemicals and free amino acids)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy source is citric acid (~5 g/100g, >90% of total acids), followed by the fermentable sugars fructose > glucose > sucrose (total ~2.5 g/100g) and secondary organic acids (malic, succinic, oxalic, lactic). Organic acids were the key FooDB omission and were added from peer-reviewed HPLC data (juice basis; whole-flesh values comparable). Nitrogen is supplied mainly as 1.1 g/100g protein plus free amino acids (asparagine/proline/serine/aspartate/glutamate dominant in citrus, unq
curation_added: citric acid (5.0 g/100g - dominant carbon source, was absent)
quantified individual sugars: D-glucose 0.98, D-fructose 1.09, sucrose 0.43 g/100g
full mineral panel quantified from USDA

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
